svg.title: Hub and spoke compared with Virtual WAN for an AVD spoke
svg.desc: Original simplified drawing. Left panel: traditional hub and spoke, a hub virtual network with shared services (firewall, gateway, Bastion, DNS resolver), joined by peering to a spoke virtual network that holds the AVD session host subnet. Right panel: Virtual WAN, a Microsoft-managed virtual hub with firewall and gateways, joined by hub connections to a shared services spoke for customer-run shared services such as DNS servers, and an AVD spoke. Three boxes below: when hub and spoke fits, when Virtual WAN fits (both from the Cloud Adoption Framework criteria), and address plan checks.
svg.text: Two ways to connect an AVD spoke to the rest of the network
The VWAN band joins the two hubs.
